topic: How much sleep school-age kids need
caption:
Bedtime battles again? 😴 Canada's guidelines say kids aged 5 to 13 need 9 to 11 hours of sleep a night, and the same bedtime and wake-up time helps most.

What time is lights-out at your house?

#ParentingTips #KidsSleep #BedtimeRoutine #CanadianParents #HealthyKids

scenes.sub: Canada's guidelines also say: same bedtime and wake-up time, every day.
